title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - DatacenterAllocation
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/DatacenterAllocation. Details specific situation within the datacenter where the service can be accessed.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'DatacenterAllocation'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

refersTo.description: Relationship. Datacenter where the service can be accessed. Links to a Datacenter entity.

floor.description: Property. The floor number of the datacenter where the service can be accessed.

rackNumber.description: Property. The Id of the datacenter rack number where the service can be accessed.

patchPanel.description: Property. The Id of the datacenter patch panel where the service can be accessed.

portNumber.description: Property. The port number on the patch panel where the service can be accessed.
